scenes.prompt: Create a new portrait 4:5 interior photograph for Scandinavian Art: a lived-in Scandinavian kitchen-dining corner in the late afternoon, just after someone has come back from picking mushrooms. The print is 50 x 70 cm portrait in a thin natural oak frame, about 52 x 72 cm framed: only slightly wider than one 48 cm Ekeryd chair, and about a third of the length of the 160 cm Bok oak table below it. It hangs centred above the far half of the table, its bottom edge about 30 cm above the tabletop, on a wall painted the warm beige of the wall reference (use the paint colour only). The table's long side runs parallel to that wall; two Ekeryd chairs are pulled up to it, one turned slightly out as if just left. On the table: the light-blue Barro oval dish filled with freshly picked chanterelles and a few ceps, a folded linen cloth with loose soil and a small knife beside it, a white mug within reach of the turned chair. Floor: the concrete floor from the board, its real tone and texture. One window on the left gives daylight, with a modest patch of low sun across part of the floor and the table legs; the far corner stays in soft shade. A convincing DSLR interior photograph, lightly developed from RAW: level camera about 150 cm high, offset to the right, 35 mm, f/8, moderate depth of field, restrained sharpening, fine wood grain and matte painted wall, no blanket glow, no HDR, no added grain. Render the artwork as part of the photograph, never pasted in: ink on matte paper behind ordinary clear glass, lit by the same window as the wall around it with gentle falloff; the glazing carries a soft, restrained reflection of the left window from this angle, and the frame casts a soft shadow to the right that agrees with the same light. No isolated glare stripe, no spotlight on the art. Reproduce the supplied artwork faithfully, same layout, colours and 5:7 proportions: a flat, graphic autumn forest on a very dark brown ground inside a cream margin, a blonde girl in a red coat and blue trousers running right with a basket, a grey dog leaping behind her, red leaves, yellow and red tree trunks with a pale moon top right, and at the bottom a large red toadstool with white spots, a white hare, a small robin on a red tree stump and scattered small mushrooms. Use only the supplied furniture; ordinary mushrooms, a cloth and a mug may complete the scene. No people, no text, no logos.

scenes.prompt: Create a new portrait 4:5 interior photograph for Scandinavian Art: a calm child's bedroom in the early evening, with signs of bedtime reading. The print is 50 x 70 cm portrait in a thin natural oak frame, about 52 x 72 cm framed: about a quarter of the length of the 205 cm low wooden bed below it. The bed stands with its long side parallel to the wall, pushed square against it with a small even gap for the skirting, never angled. The print hangs centred above the middle of the bed, its bottom edge about 40 cm above the mattress, on a wall painted the soft peach of the wall reference (use the paint colour only). Bedding: the green-and-white striped sheets from the reference, rumpled, with the duvet turned back at the pillow end. At the pillow end, the HAY Colour Crate stands on end as a bedside with a small stack of picture books and a glass of water on it; one open picture book lies face down on the duvet. Floor: the oak wood flooring from the board. One window on the right with a thin curtain gives soft evening daylight; the room is gently lit with darker corners, a small patch of warm light on the floor near the window. A convincing DSLR interior photograph, lightly developed from RAW: level camera about 145 cm high, standing slightly oblique, 35 mm, f/8, moderate depth of field, restrained sharpening, fine wood and textile texture. Render the artwork as part of the photograph, never pasted in: ink on matte paper behind clear glass, lit by the same window as the wall with visible falloff; the glazing reflects the right-hand window faintly from this angle, the frame casts a soft shadow to the left, all agreeing with one light. No glare stripe, no spotlight. Reproduce the supplied artwork faithfully, same layout, colours and 5:7 proportions: a deep navy sea filling most of the picture under a band of grey-blue sky, a small dark steamship with a white funnel on the horizon and three birds above it, and rising from the bottom a huge pale cream whale seen head-on, long and tapering upwards, with fine grooves on its throat, a small dark eye and a round blowhole near the bottom; a paler blue tail fin shows faintly in the water at the right. Grainy, printed texture. Use only the supplied furniture; books, a glass and ordinary bedding folds may complete the scene. No people, no text, no logos.

scenes.prompt: Create a new portrait 4:5 interior photograph for Scandinavian Art: a quiet winter reading corner in a Scandinavian living room on a grey afternoon. The print is 50 x 70 cm portrait in a thin natural oak frame, about 52 x 72 cm framed: roughly three quarters as wide as the 72 cm Loholm armchair beside it, and under a third of the length of the 175 cm Hem Zig Zag low shelf below it. The print hangs centred above the shelf, its bottom edge about 25 cm above the shelf top, on a wall painted the soft light yellow of the wall reference (use the paint colour only). The shelf stands square against the wall and is in use: books standing and stacked on its levels, a small ceramic bowl, a candle. The Loholm swivel armchair sits at the left end of the shelf, turned a little towards the room, with the grey Gotland wool throw draped over one arm and a book left open on the seat; a mug of tea on the shelf end within reach of the chair. Floor: the herringbone flooring from the board. One window on the left gives cool, soft winter daylight; the right side of the room is in gentle shade, midtones kept comparatively low, the art still readable. A convincing DSLR interior photograph, lightly developed from RAW: level camera about 140 cm high, straight-on to the wall, 35 mm, f/8, moderate depth of field, restrained sharpening, fine wood grain and wool texture. Render the artwork as part of the photograph, never pasted in: ink on matte paper behind clear glass, lit by the same window as the wall with visible falloff; the glazing carries a faint reflection of the left window, the frame casts a soft shadow to the right, all agreeing with one light. No glare stripe, no spotlight. Reproduce the supplied artwork faithfully, same layout, colours and 5:7 proportions: inside a cream margin, a pale ice castle with jagged towers against a dark blue night sky with small stars, a crescent moon and a dark sun-like star, flying birds; small penguins stand on the ice ledges; below, three cream polar bears, two wearing small dark crowns, meet in the middle holding a star, among blue ice floes over dark water. Grainy, printed texture. Use only the supplied furniture; books, a bowl, a candle and a mug may complete the scene. No people, no text, no logos.

reviewChecklist: Artwork identity against the original PNG at full size: same shapes, layout, colours, 5:7 ratio; reject a different picture however good the room.
Scale by measurement: pixels per cm from the named anchor on the same plane, then the frame; about 52 x 72 cm framed.
Placement: name the furniture the print hangs over and where the activity sits; both must relate (Markus willows-02 benchmark).
Glass, frame and wall together: reflection matches the actual window and camera, frame shadow and wall light follow the same source (test 21 and 24 benchmarks; Pines reservation).
Geometry: bed, table and shelf square to the wall, constant bed width, feet on the floor.
Furniture fidelity to the references; no invented furniture; containers not empty.
Record Mark's judgement separately from the self-review. Export for the shop as <slug>-room-YYYY-MM-DD.avif q70 plus .webp q88 only after Mark approves.
